description: Current constituents of a major US or developed-markets equity index — ticker, name, GICS sector, and weight — sourced from the matching iShares index-tracking ETF's daily holdings file (the closest free, point-in-time proxy for official index membership and weights; S&P/Russell do not publish those for free). Answers "what's in the S&P 500 right now", "top holdings of the Russell 2000 by weight", "which sectors make up the S&P MidCap 400". Cash, collateral and futures positions the ETF holds are excluded here — use ishares_etf_holdings for those.

index.description: Which index. One of: sp500, sp400, sp600, russell1000, russell2000, eafe.

limit.description: Max rows to return, sorted by weight descending (default 50, max 600 — pass the max to get the full index in one call).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging past `limit` (default 0).

sector.description: Optional GICS sector filter, case-insensitive substring match (e.g. "Health Care", "Energy").

name: index_constituents
title: Index Constituents
